description: This is a test source file for a hardware/software project, containing pytest-based test cases for RDk compliance and configuration handlers, specifically testing rbus data set/get functions related to device info, RFC features, non-RFC features, bootstrap parameters, and associated file creation.

methods.name: test_DeviceInfo_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Tests setting and getting device info data element via rbus.

methods.name: test_DeviceTime_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Tests setting and getting device time related data elements via rbus, including DHCPv6 client enable and NTP server.

methods.name: test_RFC_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Tests setting and getting various RFC feature data elements via rbus, such as HDMI CEC version, software download limit, firmware version, and incremental CDL enable.

methods.name: test_NonRFC_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Tests setting and getting non-RFC data elements like IP remote support, SSH enable, firmware download defer reboot, and firmware download notification.

methods.name: test_Bootstrap_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Tests setting and getting bootstrap parameters such as partner product name, Netflix ESN prefix, partner name, and SSR URL.

methods.name: test_Bootstrap_File_Creation()
methods.description: Verifies bootstrap files exist and that bootstrap parameters are written to the configuration file successfully.
